children: Louise C. Forlenza, a Director, reported the sale of Innodata common stock on September 4, 2026. The transaction was executed in multiple trades at prices ranging from $55.00 to $55.04 and the reported weighted average sale price was $55.01 per share. The total proceeds from the sale were $550,100. Following the reported transaction, Forlenza directly owns 5,424 shares of Innodata common stock, which includes 1,481 RSUs scheduled to vest by June 4, 2027 or the company’s 2027 annual meeting.
